correctness.rationale: Use 0 as opening and 1 as closing parenthesis and forbid factors with exponent strictly greater than 7/3 (not factors exactly at 7/3). The 24-letter witness 001001100100110110011011 is balanced, has nonnegative prefix heights of maximum 4, is reverse-complement invariant, contains 1001001 of period 3 and length 7 (exact exponent 7/3), and has no factor with 3*length > 7*period. An independent prefix construction exhausts every Dyck word at every even length 2..24, pruning only already-created forbidden suffixes: there are no level-4 survivors below 24 and at 24 precisely 40 level2,36 level3 and ONE level4 survivor, the witness. The original certificate and verifier code were inspected; the independent enumeration regenerated its count table. The finite classification is an exhaustive proof of the bounded minimality/uniqueness claim, not an unbounded theorem about all nesting levels.
